title: Veil and Wolf
premise: Dominic Voss has spent his life as a royal food-taster in the valley of Hollowmere, where an ancient ward keeps magic out and keeps him safe from the poison he was born vulnerable to. When the old gods stir and the court beneath the mountain begins collecting souls sold by desperate mortals, Dominic discovers his own sister bargained hers away to save his life years ago. To reclaim her soul before the debt comes due at the winter solstice, he must leave the valley for the first time, surviving a world where magic can kill him with a touch. Guided by a disgraced priestess of the waking gods and hunted by the mountain court's soul-collectors, Dominic learns that immunity was never a gift but a leash — and that justice outside the law demands a price steeper than any dish he has ever tasted. In the end, he trades his own protected soul for his sister's, shattering the valley's ward, and returns not as a taster of poisons but as something new: a mortal vessel the old gods themselves must now answer.
about_author: Juniper Thackeray is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval trial records before turning to fantasy. She writes about ordinary people caught in systems older and crueler than themselves, usually near mountains.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. A routine morning at the royal table: Dominic sips a suspect broth, tastes hemlock, and survives it as always. We learn the valley's ward, his routine, and his quiet dread. Emotional beat: controlled numbness — a man who has made survival into a profession and called it a life.

chapters.title: What the Ward Keeps Out
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. A pilgrim arrives claiming the gods answered her prayer beyond the pass. The court dismisses her; Dominic privately tests the ward's edge and feels it flicker for the first time in living memory. Emotional beat: unease — the first crack in the certainty that has contained his whole world.

chapters.title: A Debt Spoken Aloud
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. His sister Maren, feverish and terrified, confesses she sold her soul to the court beneath the mountain nineteen years ago to buy his immunity when he was a dying child. The solstice deadline is named. Emotional beat: guilt detonating under twenty years of gratitude he never questioned.

chapters.title: The Last Safe Supper
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. He tries to buy Maren's contract back through official channels; the crown's magistrates laugh him out. That night the first soul-collector crosses the weakened ward and marks their house. Emotional beat: betrayal — the law he served will not save the people he loves.

chapters.title: Crossing the Line
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. Dominic slips past the ward at dawn, vomiting and half-blind as magic floods a body built without it. He meets Sera Vane, a disgraced priestess of the waking gods, who saves him from his first collector. Emotional beat: terror transfigured into resolve.

chapters.title: The Priestess Who Lost Her God
chapters.summary: POV Sera. Her backstory: she prayed for her congregation and heard silence for thirty years until last month, when the gods woke angry and disowned their failed servants. She agrees to guide Dominic toward the mountain. Emotional beat: bitter hope between two people with nothing left to lose.

chapters.title: Roadside Miracles
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. They travel through villages where prayers are being answered at terrible exchange rates — rain for memories, healing for names. Dominic realizes the gods' return is a harvest, not a blessing. Emotional beat: dawning horror at what divinity costs the desperate.

chapters.title: The Collector's Courtesy
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. A collector named Ilvane corners them, offering to erase Maren's debt if Dominic surrenders his own protected soul instead. He refuses; they escape by burning a shrine as a decoy. Emotional beat: temptation — the easy bargain that would be so simple to accept.

chapters.title: Salt and Iron
chapters.summary: POV Sera. Sheltering in a smugglers' waystation, Sera teaches Dominic crude wards against magic using salt, iron, and deliberate disbelief. Their guarded partnership deepens into trust. Emotional beat: warmth — the first kindness either has accepted in years.

chapters.title: The Market of Small Gods
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. In a lawless trade-town they find lesser spirits selling scraps of divine favor. Dominic barters his taster's palate — his one gift — to learn the mountain court's true name and the shape of its gate. Emotional beat: sacrifice as strategy; paying with pieces of himself.

chapters.title: What Immunity Was For
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. A captured collector reveals the truth: the valley's ward wasn't protection — it was a pen. Dominic's bloodline was bred immune so the mountain court could harvest unspoiled souls later. Emotional beat: rage reframing his entire identity as livestock.

chapters.title: Sera's Confession
chapters.summary: POV Sera. She admits she once served the mountain court as its human mouthpiece and helped write the contracts — including, unknowingly, the template used on Maren. Dominic nearly abandons her. Emotional beat: forgiveness chosen over righteous anger, imperfectly.

chapters.title: The Ascent
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. They climb the mountain's hidden stair through storms of whispering voices that offer each traveler their heart's desire. Sera nearly turns back; Dominic anchors her by reciting the ingredients of every poison he has ever survived. Emotional beat: endurance — love expressed as stubbornness.

chapters.title: Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. The underworld court: a cathedral of ledgers where souls are filed like vintages. Dominic poses as a royal envoy offering the crown's tribute. Emotional beat: icy composure — the taster performing the role of his life.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Voss
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. He finds Maren's page and learns the debt is worse than confessed: her soul was collateral on his immunity, due regardless of solstice. The court offers him a clerkship — eternity of comfortable servitude. Emotional beat: despair sharpening into defiance.

chapters.title: Ilvane's Choice
chapters.summary: POV Ilvane. The collector, herself once a harvested mortal, catches Dominic fleeing with the stolen page — and lets him go, having waited centuries for someone to refuse the bargain cleanly. Emotional beat: unexpected mercy from the machinery of the damned.

chapters.title: The Flight Down
chapters.summary: POV Sera. Hunted through the mountain's roots, Sera burns her last connection to her old god to hold the gate open, knowing it may kill her. They escape as the court wakes fully. Emotional beat: grief and awe — faith restored at the moment of its greatest cost.

chapters.title: Solstice Eve
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. Back at the valley's edge, the ward is failing and collectors mass for the harvest. Dominic realizes stealing the page isn't enough — the contract must be paid or broken at the altar stone tonight. Emotional beat: grim clarity; no more running.

chapters.title: The Altar Stone
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. Climax part one: Dominic offers his own soul — the bred, unspoiled vintage the court has wanted all along — in exchange for Maren's. The mountain court accepts, and begins to take him. Emotional beat: terror and terrible peace in equal measure.

chapters.title: What the Old Gods Owe
chapters.summary: POV Sera. At the moment of collection, the woken old gods intervene: they owe the mountain court an ancient grievance, and a freely offered mortal soul is leverage. They void the contract — but claim Dominic as their vessel and answerable servant. Emotional beat: salvation that is also a new binding.

chapters.title: Aftertaste
chapters.summary: POV Dominic. Maren wakes free; the ward is gone and the valley must face the world without its pen. Dominic, now半-divine, tastes the air and finds it full of both poison and prayer. Emotional beat: bittersweet homecoming — safety traded for significance.

chapters.title: Veil and Wolf
chapters.summary: POV Dominic, epilogue. Months later, Dominic walks the borderlands settling debts the courts above and below ignore, with Sera at his side and Maren rebuilding Hollowmere. The old gods answer his prayers now — carefully. Emotional beat: earned justice outside the law, and a man finally at home in his own skin.
